visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a stark white background. Two anthropomorphic cats are centered. The cat on the left wears a dark grey hooded cloak, holding a small brown basket containing red apples. The cat on the right is dressed as Snow White with a blue bodice, yellow skirt, and a red bow in its hair. The text '從前從前' is displayed in bold black font at the top. (2) As the story progresses, additional lines of text appear: '有一個巫婆拿蘋果給白爛公主吃'. The witch cat extends its left hand, offering a single red apple to the Snow White cat. The characters are rendered in a clean, minimalist 2D animation style with flat colors and simple outlines. (3) The Snow White cat begins to eat the apples rapidly. A long string of text '她一直吃一直吃一直吃一直吃一直吃一直吃一直吃一直吃' fills the upper half of the frame. The witch cat continuously hands over apples, and the Snow White cat's belly visibly expands with each bite, showing a series of quick animation loops representing the repetitive action. (4) The text changes to '然後她就吃飽了'. The Snow White cat's belly is now huge and round, filling the bottom of the frame. It has a satisfied, squinty-eyed expression with its tongue sticking out. The witch cat stands to the left, looking shocked with three question marks '???' floating above its head. (5) The screen cuts to a plain white background with the words 'THE END' written in large, black, hand-drawn style capital letters centered in the frame. The brand copyright '©MOCHI DAD/THAT FISH CORP.' remains visible at the very bottom throughout the entire sequence.
